workstreams.title: You handle today · launch film
workstreams.detail: The final cut combines owner footage, the real app components and staged story data. The edit and browser playback are verified. Your narration and camera remain.
workstreams.proof: Fresh ffprobe: 180.053333 seconds. The official judging criteria say under three minutes. This is a staged demonstration, not a real supplier order.

workstreams.proof: Fresh production queries found 20 tagged product browser IDs and zero non-test inquiries, confirmed bookings or pilot starts. Launch checks were excluded.
